newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss Aug advertising volume drops 2.7 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Swiss Aug advertising volume drops 2.7 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Overall Swiss advertising volume dropped 2.7 percent in August compared with the year-earlier month, according to figures compiled by Media Focus. It gave no absolute figures.
Volume was down 2.2 percent in the first eight months of the year compared with the same 1995 period.

Newspaper advertising was up 0.8 percent in the first eight months, while TV ads were off 1.8 percent. Cinema advertising rose 36.1 percent from the first eight months of 1995, while teletext was down 2.3 percent and billboards up 2.2 percent.
